agent.IncompleteResponseError: Raise "Max. tokens" under "Advanced" for this agent, or ask for a shorter answer in its task.
agent.OutputLimitReached: Raise "Max. tokens" under "Advanced" for this agent, or ask for a shorter answer in its task.
agent.ContextWindowExceeded: Shorten the input or the agent's knowledge, or choose a model with a larger context window.
agent.RefusalError: Check the task and the input and describe the job more clearly. Some content a model always declines.
agent.MaxToolRoundsError: Raise "Max. tool rounds" under "Advanced" for this agent, or say in its task when it is done.
agent.StructuredOutputError: Check the fields under "Output format"; a few clearly described fields help. Often continuing the run is enough.
agent.UnexpectedResponseError: Continue the run. If it happens again, the technical details help the provider's support.
agent.EvaluationFailedError: Read the check's reasoning at the step and adjust the task or the criteria.
agent.ToolExecutionError: The technical details name the tool and its error. Check the tool under "Tools".

run.api_error_auth: Check the key under Settings → AI providers and test the connection there.
run.api_error_rate_limit: Wait a moment and continue the run. Fewer runs at the same time or a higher limit with the provider help for good.
run.api_error_server: This is not caused by your workflow. Continue the run in a few minutes.
run.api_error_connection: Check the internet connection, firewall or proxy, then continue the run.
run.api_error_invalid: Check the agent's model and settings; the technical details show the provider's answer.
run.api_error_status: Check the agent's model and settings; the technical details show the provider's answer.
run.budget_exceeded: Raise the budget in the workflow settings, or continue the run with a new budget.
run.time_limit: Raise the time limit under "Limits" in the workflow settings if the run needs more time.
run.step_limit: Raise the step limit under "Limits" in the workflow settings, or check for loops.
run.orchestration_limit: Raise "Maximum decisions" on the orchestrator, or say in its instructions when the task is done.
